🎃 BWAH Halloween Update — Grab the Seed. Escape the **BACKROOMS!**

Get ready for a new challenge: steal a seed and escape before the creature catches you! Finding the seed is only the beginning. Can you make it out with your prize?

Something is lurking in the Backrooms… and you’re about to enter its territory.
[media]

Enjoy exploring the new Halloween setting!

[media]

- 👁️ Explore the Backrooms and face the creature lurking inside.
- 🌱 Grab a seed and run for the exit in a new escape minigame.
- 👻 Dress up with new Halloween cosmetics.
- 🗓️ Discover new seeds every week throughout the Halloween event.

Go in for the seed. Run for your life!


# 🌱 Welcome to Bwah - Grow a Garden in VR 🌱
Grow plants, sell for profit, and build your dream garden! Hunt rare seeds, unlock wild mutations, and flex your ultimate garden. Stay tuned for weekly updates!

**🧑‍🌾 How to Play**
- Buy a seed and grab it
- Place it in your garden
- Wait and watch it grow
- Harvest and earn BIG

Remember, your garden literally grows while you’re offline! ⭐️
